decision_record.calculation: Fixture (equity 10000, ndx 0.5): complete bars -> 2 intents (QQQ 10, BIL 55). BIL bars missing -> control emits 1 intent (QQQ only) and freezes; treatment emits 0, does not consume the freeze, and emits the full 2-intent plan on the next pass with complete bars.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change rule on the same first pass of the session: emits the priced subset and consumes the ENH first-evaluation freeze; the unpriced leg is never revisited that session.
decision_record.experiment: Adapters3 A/B on identical views: treatment (switch ON) vs control (switch OFF = legacy subset emit), plus a completion pass proving the freeze survives the deferral. Falsifier: a pass where the subset emit would have been the complete plan (no leg unpriced) — gate passes it through untouched.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution completeness: the ENH freeze makes the first pass the ONLY pass, so a transient missing bar (one leg unserved on that cycle) converts a 5-minute data gap into a full-session missed rebalance.
decision_record.transfer: The book's Nasdaq exposure is the edge; it is paid only when the FULL rebalance (QQQ/TQQQ/BIL legs) executes. A partially priced plan that executes its priced subset leaves the book at an unintended exposure for the whole session.

switch: extra.aurelia_ndx_enh2.complete_plan default ON; OFF restores the pre-change emit-and-freeze rule exactly
